title: Member numbers linked in the app before the 2 Nov desk check are never checked again, and the gym cannot see or undo them
what: Before the 2 Nov security fix, anyone with the gym's poster code could type a member's mobile number at check-in and be linked to that member (plan, trainer, measurements, diet, workout plans). The fix makes new typed numbers wait for the desk to confirm them under 'Numbers to confirm'. Links made before the fix were left as they were: they are trusted for every later check-in, they never appear in 'Numbers to confirm', and the admin app has no list of linked numbers and no way to remove one.
expected: Links made before the desk check are shown once to the desk to confirm (or are reset so the next scan asks the desk), and the gym can remove a wrong link.
how_often: for every number linked before 2 Nov 2026
fix_line: Put pre-fix links into Numbers to confirm once, and add a remove link button

items.reason: Web panel area: no install package, sideload, Play or watch split here. Saved browser data from older versions is read leniently (an old owner key without a signed-in person still works). Every feature whose database update is not on yet hides itself with one quiet note; old posters on the old address and old /c/ and /m/ links keep working; old member apps still get the old check-in refusal words. Open tab across an update: each 'not on the server yet' answer is remembered for the life of the page, so a feature switched on in the database stays hidden in an open tab until reload: same no-reload-notice fault as FN-B-time-panel-assistant-01.

Day and time words use India time; 'today' money and 'yesterday' use the India day; dates older than 30 days show the year; timed messages are limited to 30 days ahead, so year end is fine; 29 Feb birthdays are wished on 28 Feb (panel and phone). Staff leaves: a dead sign-in sends the panel back to the sign-in door, and that person's alerts on a device stop (push rows die with the session or a removed staff). Free trial joiners get a last day; offers show ended and left members. Owner changes phone or clears the browser: a gym kept in the browser loses its shop for good (existing FN-L14-panel-shop-02). Pause requests past plan end and member messages dropped after 90 days: existing ids. Not opened for 6 months: browser notes are kept only 3 to 4 days, nothing goes stale. Gym pauses or closes: not in this area.

The desk check of typed member numbers applies only to new links; links made before it stay trusted with no re-check. Other new rules here keep old users working: old posters and links are served for good, the one gym link leaves old join links working, the welcome reminder goes only to members whose plan or app join is under 7 days old.
No path: 'Numbers to confirm' lists only requests made after the fix, and the App members list has no way to see or remove an existing link.

This area has no What's new, dots or tips. New-order pop-ups: the first load never announces the backlog, only orders that arrive later. 'New' on an order is its status, not a version mark. Member news on Today shows once per visit and is kept 4 days; a new browser can show the last 3 days of news once, which are real news to that person. 'Seen by' never counts more than were sent.
Rule applied: no new mark on old things found.
